This indicates that Oblonganoside C may influence the activity of these kinases, which could modulate the expression or function of the Interleukin-1 receptor antagonist protein. The presence of multiple indirect pathways supports the idea that Oblonganoside C may interact with the signaling network that regulates this protein, potentially through kinase-mediated mechanisms. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for Oblonganoside C in modulating inflammatory responses by affecting the Interleukin-1 receptor antagonist protein, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
